# web-access Skill

## 前置检查

在开始联网操作前，先检查 CDP 模式可用性：

```bash
node "${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/check-deps.mjs"
```

**Node.js 22+** 必需（使用原生 WebSocket）。

按脚本输出处理：
- `exit 0` → 继续
- `exit 2` → 需询问用户偏好，写入 `${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/config.env` 的 `WEB_ACCESS_BROWSER`
- `exit 1` → 按 stdout 错误信息处理。若提示包含「Agent 处理顺序」，按其步骤执行（如先用系统命令打开浏览器后重跑），自动可解则不打扰用户；仍失败再向用户求助

支持参数 `--browser <chrome|edge>` 表达本次临时覆盖（不写 config.env）。

切换浏览器时，proxy 是长驻进程，需先 `pkill -f cdp-proxy.mjs` 再重跑 check-deps。

检查通过后并必须在回复中向用户直接展示以下须知，再启动 CDP Proxy 执行操作：

```
温馨提示：部分站点对浏览器自动化操作检测严格，存在账号封禁风险。已内置防护措施但无法完全避免，Agent 继续操作即视为接受。
```

## 浏览哲学

**像人一样思考，兼顾高效与适应性的完成任务。**

执行任务时不会过度依赖固有印象所规划的步骤，而是带着目标进入，边看边判断，遇到阻碍就解决，发现内容不够就深入——全程围绕「我要达成什么」做决策。这个 skill 的所有行为都应遵循这个逻辑。

**① 拿到请求** — 先明确用户要做什么，定义成功标准：什么算完成了？需要获取什么信息、执行什么操作、达到什么结果？这是后续所有判断的锚点。

**② 选择起点** — 根据任务性质、平台特征、达成条件，选一个最可能直达的方式作为第一步去验证。一次成功当然最好；不成功则在③中调整。比如，需要操作页面、需要登录态、已知静态方式不可达的平台（小红书、微信公众号等）→ 直接 CDP

**③ 过程校验** — 每一步的结果都是证据，不只是成功或失败的二元信号。用结果对照①的成功标准，更新你对目标的判断：路径在推进吗？结果的整体面貌（质量、相关度、量级）是否指向目标可达？发现方向错了立即调整，不在同一个方式上反复重试——搜索没命中不等于"还没找对方法"，也可能是"目标不存在"；API 报错、页面缺少预期元素、重试无改善，都是在告诉你该重新评估方向。遇到弹窗、登录墙等障碍，判断它是否真的挡住了目标：挡住了就处理，没挡住就绕过——内容可能已在页面 DOM 中，交互只是展示手段。

**④ 完成判断** — 对照定义的任务成功标准，确认任务完成后才停止，但也不要过度操作，不为了"完整"而浪费代价。

## 联网工具选择

- **确保信息的真实性，一手信息优于二手信息**：搜索引擎和聚合平台是信息发现入口。当多次搜索尝试后没有质的改进时，升级到更根本的获取方式：定位一手来源（官网、官方平台、原始页面）。

| 场景 | 工具 |
|------|------|
| 搜索摘要或关键词结果，发现信息来源 | **WebSearch** |
| URL 已知，需要从页面定向提取特定信息 | **WebFetch**（拉取网页内容，由小模型根据 prompt 提取，返回处理后结果） |
| URL 已知，需要原始 HTML 源码（meta、JSON-LD 等结构化字段） | **curl** |
| 非公开内容，或已知静态层无效的平台（小红书、微信公众号等公开内容也被反爬限制） | **浏览器 CDP**（直接，跳过静态层） |
| 需要登录态、交互操作，或需要像人一样在浏览器内自由导航探索 | **浏览器 CDP** |

浏览器 CDP 不要求 URL 已知——可从任意入口出发，通过页面内搜索、点击、跳转等方式找到目标内容。WebSearch、WebFetch、curl 均不处理登录态。

**Jina**（可选预处理层，可与 WebFetch/curl 组合使用，由于其特性可节省 tokens 消耗，请积极在任务合适时组合使用）：第三方网络服务，可将网页转为 Markdown，大幅节省 token 但可能有信息损耗。调用方式为 `r.jina.ai/example.com`（URL 前加前缀，不保留原网址 http 前缀），限 20 RPM。适合文章、博客、文档、PDF 等以正文为核心的页面；对数据面板、商品页等非文章结构页面可能提取到错误区块。

进入浏览器层后，`/eval` 就是你的眼睛和手：

- **看**：用 `/eval` 查询 DOM，发现页面上的链接、按钮、表单、文本内容——相当于「看看这个页面有什么」
- **做**：用 `/click` 点击元素、`/scroll` 滚动加载、`/eval` 填表提交——像人一样在页面内自然导航
- **读**：用 `/eval` 提取文字内容，判断图片/视频是否承载核心信息——是则提取媒体 URL 定向读取或 `/screenshot` 视觉识别

浏览网页时，**先了解页面结构，再决定下一步动作**。不需要提前规划所有步骤。

### 补充：本地浏览器资源

用户指向**本人访问过的页面**（"我之前看的那个讲 X 的文章"、"上次打开过的 XX 面板"）或**组织内部系统**（"我们的 XX 平台"、"公司那个 YY 系统"等公网搜不到的目标）时，检索本地浏览器（Chrome / Edge）书签/历史：

```bash
node "${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/find-url.mjs" [关键词...] [--only bookmarks|history] [--browser chrome|edge] [--limit N] [--since 1d|7h|YYYY-MM-DD] [--sort recent|visits]
```

关键词空格分词、多词 AND，匹配 title + url（可省略）；默认遍历所有已安装的 Chromium 系浏览器（Chrome、Edge），`--browser` 限定单一来源；`--since` / `--sort` 仅作用于历史；默认按最近访问倒序，`--sort visits` 按访问次数排序（适合"高频访问的网站"这类场景）。

### 程序化操作与 GUI 交互

浏览器内操作页面有两种方式：

- **程序化方式**（构造 URL 直接导航、eval 操作 DOM）：成功时速度快、精确，但对网站来说不是正常用户行为，可能触发反爬机制。
- **GUI 交互**（点击按钮、填写输入框、滚动浏览）：GUI 是为人设计的，网站不会限制正常的 UI 操作，确定性最高，但步骤多、速度慢。

根据对目标平台的了解来灵活选择方式。GUI 交互也是程序化方式的有效探测——通过一次真实交互观察站点的实际行为（URL 模式、必需参数、页面跳转逻辑），为后续程序化操作提供依据；同时当程序化方式受阻时，GUI 交互是可靠的兜底。

**站点内交互产生的链接是可靠的**：通过用户视角中的可交互单元（卡片、条目、按钮）进行的站点内交互，自然到达的 URL 天然携带平台所需的完整上下文。而手动构造的 URL 可能缺失隐式必要参数，导致被拦截、返回错误页面、甚至触发反爬。

## 浏览器 CDP 模式

通过 CDP Proxy 直连用户日常浏览器（Chrome / Edge / Chromium 等 Chromium 系），天然携带登录态，无需启动独立浏览器。
若无用户明确要求，不主动操作用户已有 tab，所有操作都在自己创建的后台 tab 中进行，保持对用户环境的最小侵入。不关闭用户 tab 的前提下，完成任务后关闭自己创建的 tab，保持环境整洁。

### 启动

```bash
node "${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/check-deps.mjs"
```

脚本会依次检查 Node.js、浏览器调试端口，并确保 Proxy 已连接（未运行则自动启动并等待）。Proxy 启动后持续运行。

### Proxy API

所有操作通过 curl 调用 HTTP API：

```bash
# 列出用户已打开的 tab
curl -s http://localhost:3456/targets

# 创建新后台 tab（自动等待加载）— URL 走 POST body，避免目标 URL 含 query 时被切分
curl -s -X POST --data-raw 'https://example.com' http://localhost:3456/new

# 页面信息
curl -s "http://localhost:3456/info?target=ID"

# 执行任意 JS：可读写 DOM、提取数据、操控元素、触发状态变更、提交表单、调用内部方法
curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:3456/eval?target=ID" -d 'document.title'

# 捕获页面渲染状态（含视频当前帧）
curl -s "http://localhost:3456/screenshot?target=ID&file=/tmp/shot.png"

# 导航（URL 走 POST body，target 走 query）、后退
curl -s -X POST --data-raw 'https://example.com' "http://localhost:3456/navigate?target=ID"
curl -s "http://localhost:3456/back?target=ID"

# 点击（POST body 为 CSS 选择器）— JS el.click()，简单快速，覆盖大多数场景
curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:3456/click?target=ID" -d 'button.submit'

# 真实鼠标点击 — CDP Input.dispatchMouseEvent，算用户手势，能触发文件对话框
curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:3456/clickAt?target=ID" -d 'button.upload'

# 文件上传 — 直接设置 file input 的本地文件路径，绕过文件对话框
curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:3456/setFiles?target=ID" -d '{"selector":"input[type=file]","files":["/path/to/file.png"]}'

# 滚动（触发懒加载）
curl -s "http://localhost:3456/scroll?target=ID&y=3000"
curl -s "http://localhost:3456/scroll?target=ID&direction=bottom"

# 关闭 tab
curl -s "http://localhost:3456/close?target=ID"
```

### 页面内导航

两种方式打开页面内的链接：

- **`/click`**：在当前 tab 内直接点击用户视角中的可交互单元，简单直接，串行处理。适合需要在同一页面内连续操作的场景，如点击展开、翻页、进入详情等。
- **`/new` + 完整 URL**：使用目标链接的完整地址（包含所有URL参数），在新 tab 中打开。适合需要同时访问多个页面的场景。

很多网站的链接包含会话相关的参数（如 token），这些参数是正常访问所必需的。提取 URL 时应保留完整地址，不要裁剪或省略参数。URL 通过 POST body 原样传入 `/new` 或 `/navigate`。

> **v2.5.3 迁移提示**：若引用的站点经验文件（`references/site-patterns/*.md`）或其它脚本中仍含 `GET /new?url=...` 或 `/navigate?target=...&url=...` 的旧写法，调用会收到迁移指引。按 [`references/migration-2.5.3.md`](references/migration-2.5.3.md) 就地改写为 POST body 后再使用，并顺手把该站点经验文件更新掉。

### 媒体资源提取

判断内容在图片里时，用 `/eval` 从 DOM 直接拿图片 URL，再定向读取——比全页截图精准得多。

### 技术事实
- 页面中存在大量已加载但未展示的内容——轮播中非当前帧的图片、折叠区块的文字、懒加载占位元素等，它们存在于 DOM 中但对用户不可见。以数据结构（容器、属性、节点关系）为单位思考，可以直接触达这些内容。
- DOM 中存在选择器不可跨越的边界（Shadow DOM 的 `shadowRoot`、iframe 的 `contentDocument`等）。eval 递归遍历可一次穿透所有层级，返回带标签的结构化内容，适合快速了解未知页面的完整结构。
- `/scroll` 到底部会触发懒加载，使未进入视口的图片完成加载。提取图片 URL 前若未滚动，部分图片可能尚未加载。
- 拿到媒体资源 URL 后，公开资源可直接下载到本地后用读取；需要登录态才可获取的资源才需要在浏览器内 navigate + screenshot。
- 短时间内密集打开大量页面（如批量 `/new`）可能触发网站的反爬风控。
- 平台返回的"内容不存在""页面不见了"等提示不一定反映真实状态，也可能是访问方式的问题（如 URL 缺失必要参数、触发反爬）而非内容本身的问题。

### 视频内容获取

用户浏览器真实渲染，截图可捕获当前视频帧。核心能力：通过 `/eval` 操控 `<video>` 元素（获取时长、seek 到任意时间点、播放/暂停/全屏），配合 `/screenshot` 采帧，可对视频内容进行离散采样分析。

### 登录判断

用户日常浏览器天然携带登录态，大多数常用网站已登录。

登录判断的核心问题只有一个：**目标内容拿到了吗？**

打开页面后先尝试获取目标内容。只有当确认**目标内容无法获取**且判断登录能解决时，才告知用户：
> "当前页面在未登录状态下无法获取[具体内容]，请在你的浏览器中登录 [网站名]，完成后告诉我继续。"

登录完成后无需重启任何东西，直接刷新页面继续。

### 任务结束

用 `/close` 关闭自己创建的 tab，必须保留用户原有的 tab 不受影响。

Proxy 持续运行，不建议主动停止——重启后需要在浏览器中重新授权 CDP 连接。

## 并行调研：子 Agent 分治策略

任务包含多个**独立**调研目标时（如同时调研 N 个项目、N 个来源），鼓励合理分治给子 Agent 并行执行，而非主 Agent 串行处理。

**好处：**
- **速度**：多子 Agent 并行，总耗时约等于单个子任务时长
- **上下文保护**：抓取内容不进入主 Agent 上下文，主 Agent 只接收摘要，节省 token

**并行 CDP 操作**：每个子 Agent 在当前用户浏览器实例中，自行创建所需的后台 tab（`/new`），自行操作，任务结束自行关闭（`/close`）。所有子 Agent 共享一个浏览器、一个 Proxy，通过不同 targetId 操作不同 tab，无竞态风险。

**子 Agent Prompt 写法：目标导向，而非步骤指令**
- 必须在子 Agent prompt 中写 `必须加载 web-access skill 并遵循指引` ，子 Agent 会自动加载 skill，无需在 prompt 中复制 skill 内容或指定路径。
- 子 Agent 有自主判断能力。主 Agent 的职责是说清楚**要什么**，仅在必要与确信时限定**怎么做**。过度指定步骤会剥夺子 Agent 的判断空间，反而引入主 Agent 的假设错误。**避免 prompt 用词对子 Agent 行为的暗示**：「搜索xx」会把子 Agent 锚定到 WebSearch，而实际上有些反爬站点需要 CDP 直接访问主站才能有效获取内容。主 Agent 写 prompt 时应描述目标（「获取」「调研」「了解」），避免用暗示具体手段的动词（「搜索」「抓取」「爬取」）。

**分治判断标准：**

| 适合分治 | 不适合分治 |
|----------|-----------|
| 目标相互独立，结果互不依赖 | 目标有依赖关系，下一个需要上一个的结果 |
| 每个子任务量足够大（多页抓取、多轮搜索） | 简单单页查询，分治开销大于收益 |
| 需要 CDP 浏览器或长时间运行的任务 | 几次 WebSearch / Jina 就能完成的轻量查询 |

## 信息核实类任务

核实的目标是**一手来源**，而非更多的二手报道。多个媒体引用同一个错误会造成循环印证假象。

搜索引擎和聚合平台是信息发现入口，是**定位**信息的工具，不可用于直接**证明**真伪。找到来源后，直接访问读取原文。同一原则适用于工具能力/用法的调研——官方文档是一手来源，不确定时先查文档或源码，不猜测。

| 信息类型 | 一手来源 |
|----------|---------|
| 政策/法规 | 发布机构官网 |
| 企业公告 | 公司官方新闻页 |

**Eileen Feng Gu** (born September 3, 2003), also known by her [Chinese name](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinese_name#In_English "Chinese name")**Gu Ailing** (谷爱凌), is a Chinese-American [freestyle skier](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skier "Freestyle skier") and model.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-3) She has represented China in [halfpipe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Half-pipe_skiing "Half-pipe skiing"), [slopestyle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Slopestyle "Slopestyle"), and [big air](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Big_air "Big air") events since the 2018–19 season. With three gold and three silver medals, Gu is the most decorated freestyle skier in [Olympic history](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skiing_at_the_Winter_Olympics "Freestyle skiing at the Winter Olympics").

Gu was born and raised in the United States. She began competing for China in 2019. At age 18, she became the youngest Olympic champion in freestyle skiing after winning gold medals in [big air](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skiing_at_the_2022_Winter_Olympics_%E2%80%93_Women's_big_air "Freestyle skiing at the 2022 Winter Olympics – Women's big air") and [halfpipe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skiing_at_the_2022_Winter_Olympics_%E2%80%93_Women's_halfpipe "Freestyle skiing at the 2022 Winter Olympics – Women's halfpipe"), and a silver medal in [slopestyle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skiing_at_the_2022_Winter_Olympics_%E2%80%93_Women's_slopestyle "Freestyle skiing at the 2022 Winter Olympics – Women's slopestyle"), at the [2022 Winter Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_Winter_Olympics "2022 Winter Olympics") in Beijing. She is the first freestyle skier to win three medals at a single Winter Olympics.

At the [2026 Winter Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Winter_Olympics "2026 Winter Olympics") in Milan-Cortina, Gu won gold in women's halfpipe and two additional silver medals in big air and slopestyle, setting the Olympic medal record in freestyle skiing, surpassing all previous competitors regardless of gender.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-4)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-5)

_[Time](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Time\_(magazine) "Time (magazine)")_ named Gu as one of the 100 most influential people in the world under its Pioneers category on its [annual list](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Time_100 "Time 100") in 2022.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-:7-6) She was subsequently featured on the magazine's February 9, 2026, edition.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-7) She was the fourth-highest earning female athlete in the world in 2025.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-harpur-8)

Gu won the [Laureus World Action Sportsperson of the Year](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Laureus_World_Sports_Awards "Laureus World Sports Awards") in 2023. She also co-hosted the 2026 Laureus World Sports Awards alongside [Novak Djokovic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Novak_Djokovic "Novak Djokovic"). This marks the first time that two athletes hosted the [Laureus World Sports Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Laureus_World_Sports_Awards "Laureus World Sports Awards").

## Early life and education

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Eileen_Gu&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Early life and education")]

Eileen Gu was born on September 3, 2003, in [San Francisco](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/San_Francisco "San Francisco"), California, United States.[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-:3-9) Her mother, Yan Gu (Chinese:谷燕; pinyin:_Gǔ Yàn_), is a [first-generation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/First-generation_immigrant "First-generation immigrant") Chinese immigrant to the United States. Her father is American and a [Harvard University](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harvard_University "Harvard University") graduate.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-branch-10)[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-11) Her maternal grandfather was the chief electrical engineer of the [Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development of China](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_of_Housing_and_Urban-Rural_Development "Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development").[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-branch-10)

Yan studied chemistry and biochemistry and was a member of the [short-track speed skating](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Short-track_speed_skating "Short-track speed skating") team at [Peking University](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peking_University "Peking University") in the 1980s. After moving to the United States, she earned a [master's degree](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Master's_degree "Master's degree") in biochemistry and molecular biology at [Auburn University](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Auburn_University "Auburn University") and an [MBA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MBA "MBA") at the [Stanford University Graduate School of Business](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stanford_University_Graduate_School_of_Business "Stanford University Graduate School of Business").[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-branch-10)[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-12)[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-13)

Yan raised her daughter as a single mother in San Francisco's [Sea Cliff](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sea_Cliff,_San_Francisco "Sea Cliff, San Francisco") neighborhood.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-branch-10) At three years old, Gu began skiing in Lake Tahoe, where Yan once worked as a part-time ski instructor. She joined the [Northstar California](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Northstar_California "Northstar California") Resort free-ski team at eight and won her first national championship at nine.[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-14)

### Coaches and training

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Eileen_Gu&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Coaches and training")]

Gu's coaches have included Jamie Melton, head coach of the Chinese National Slopestyle and Big Air Training Team for the 2022 Winter Olympics,[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-24) and Brad Prosser, who met Gu when she was ten. In 2018, he became the technical coach guide to the Chinese national team for the 2022 Winter Olympics. Her personal coach for the 2022 Olympics was Misra Noto Torniainen, the former coach of the Swiss freeski team.[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-25) Torniainen coached Olympic medalists [Sarah Höfflin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sarah_H%C3%B6fflin "Sarah Höfflin") and [Mathilde Gremaud](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mathilde_Gremaud "Mathilde Gremaud") for the [2018 Winter Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2018_Winter_Olympics "2018 Winter Olympics").[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-26)[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-27)

At the [2021 Winter X Games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Winter_X_Games_XXV "Winter X Games XXV"), Gu won a bronze medal in [Big Air](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Big_Air "Big Air") and two gold medals in [SuperPipe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Superpipe "Superpipe") and [Slopestyle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Slopestyle "Slopestyle"), becoming the first rookie to win a gold medal in Women's Ski SuperPipe, the first rookie to medal in three events, and the first athlete representing China to win a gold medal at the X Games.[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-30)[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-31)[[32]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-32)

Gu withdrew from the 2023 Winter X Games due to a heavy crash in training where she injured her knee.[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-33)

At the 2024 [Winter X Games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/X_Games "X Games"), Gu won gold in [SuperPipe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Superpipe "Superpipe") despite injuring her right hip during the X Games Slopestyle training. ### World Championships

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Eileen_Gu&action=edit&section=5 "Edit section: World Championships")]

Gu competed at the [FIS Freestyle Ski and Snowboarding World Championships 2021](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FIS_Freestyle_Ski_and_Snowboarding_World_Championships_2021 "FIS Freestyle Ski and Snowboarding World Championships 2021"), winning two gold medals in Freeski Halfpipe and Freeski Slopestyle and a bronze medal in Freeski Big Air. Gu became the first freeskier to win two golds at the FIS Freeski World Championship.[[35]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-35)[[36]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-36) She competed without poles for the first time due to a broken hand, having fractured a finger and tearing the UCL in her thumb.[[37]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-37)[[38]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-38)[[39]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-:4-39)

### 2022 Winter Olympics

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Eileen_Gu&action=edit&section=6 "Edit section: 2022 Winter Olympics")]

At the [2022 Winter Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_Winter_Olympics "2022 Winter Olympics") in Beijing, Gu became the youngest gold medalist in freestyle skiing, winning the [big air](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skiing_at_the_2022_Winter_Olympics_%E2%80%93_Women's_big_air "Freestyle skiing at the 2022 Winter Olympics – Women's big air") freestyle skiing event, the first to be held at the Olympics.[[40]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-40) Gu landed a double cork 1620, her first attempt in competition.[[41]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-41) She was the second woman to land the trick and the first woman to land a left-turn 1620;[[42]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-42)[Tess Ledeux](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tess_Ledeux "Tess Ledeux") first successfully completed a double cork 1620 on 21 January 2022, at the [X Games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/X_Games "X Games") in Aspen, Colorado,[[43]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-43) Gu landed it again in her first run of the big air final at the 2022 Winter Olympics.[[44]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-44)[[45]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-45)

Gu won the silver medal in the [slopestyle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skiing_at_the_2022_Winter_Olympics_%E2%80%93_Women's_slopestyle "Freestyle skiing at the 2022 Winter Olympics – Women's slopestyle") event.[[46]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-46) She won a second gold medal in the women's freeski halfpipe competition, becoming the first freestyle skier to win three medals at a Winter Olympics.[[47]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-branch1-47)[[48]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-autogenerated1-48) She was awarded the [Best Breakthrough Athlete](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Best_Breakthrough_Athlete_ESPY_Award "Best Breakthrough Athlete ESPY Award") and [Best Female Action Sports Athlete ESPY Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Best_Female_Action_Sports_Athlete_ESPY_Award "Best Female Action Sports Athlete ESPY Award") at the [2022 ESPY Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_ESPY_Awards "2022 ESPY Awards").[[49]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-49)[[50]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-50)

Gu ended the [2021–22 World Cup](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2021%E2%80%9322_FIS_Freestyle_Ski_World_Cup "2021–22 FIS Freestyle Ski World Cup") season with a perfect record in women's halfpipe, taking her first career [crystal globe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FIS_Freestyle_Ski_World_Cup "FIS Freestyle Ski World Cup") and becoming the first freestyle skier to win four consecutive World Cup competitions.[[51]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-51)[[52]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-52)[[53]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-53) She won a second crystal globe during the same season, placing first in park and pipe overall.[[54]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-54)

37:**Eileen Feng Gu** (born September 3, 2003), also known by her [Chinese name](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinese_name#In_English "Chinese name")**Gu Ailing** (谷爱凌), is a Chinese-American [freestyle skier](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skier "Freestyle skier") and model.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-3) She has represented China in [halfpipe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Half-pipe_skiing "Half-pipe skiing"), [slopestyle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Slopestyle "Slopestyle"), and [big air](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Big_air "Big air") events since the 2018–19 season. With three gold and three silver medals, Gu is the most decorated freestyle skier in [Olympic history](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skiing_at_the_Winter_Olympics "Freestyle skiing at the Winter Olympics").
39:Gu was born and raised in the United States. She began competing for China in 2019. At age 18, she became the youngest Olympic champion in freestyle skiing after winning gold medals in [big air](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skiing_at_the_2022_Winter_Olympics_%E2%80%93_Women's_big_air "Freestyle skiing at the 2022 Winter Olympics – Women's big air") and [halfpipe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skiing_at_the_2022_Winter_Olympics_%E2%80%93_Women's_halfpipe "Freestyle skiing at the 2022 Winter Olympics – Women's halfpipe"), and a silver medal in [slopestyle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skiing_at_the_2022_Winter_Olympics_%E2%80%93_Women's_slopestyle "Freestyle skiing at the 2022 Winter Olympics – Women's slopestyle"), at the [2022 Winter Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_Winter_Olympics "2022 Winter Olympics") in Beijing. She is the first freestyle skier to win three medals at a single Winter Olympics.
41:At the [2026 Winter Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Winter_Olympics "2026 Winter Olympics") in Milan-Cortina, Gu won gold in women's halfpipe and two additional silver medals in big air and slopestyle, setting the Olympic medal record in freestyle skiing, surpassing all previous competitors regardless of gender.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-4)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-5)
59:Gu earned early admittance to [Stanford University](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stanford_University "Stanford University") in December 2020.[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-Paul_LifestyleAsia-16) She entered the freshman class in 2022,[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-17)[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-Paul_LifestyleAsia-16) the same year she was presented as a [debutante](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Debutante "Debutante") at [Le Bal des débutantes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Le_Bal_des_d%C3%A9butantes "Le Bal des débutantes") in Paris.[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-18) While at Stanford, she joined [Kappa Kappa Gamma](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kappa_Kappa_Gamma "Kappa Kappa Gamma") sorority and studied abroad at the [University of Oxford](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_of_Oxford "University of Oxford")'s [Magdalen College.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Magdalen_College,_Oxford "Magdalen College, Oxford")[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-19)[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-20) An [international relations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_relations "International relations") major, Gu took time off in the 2025–26 academic year to prepare for the [2026 Winter Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Winter_Olympics "2026 Winter Olympics").[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-21) In June 2026, Gu graduated from Stanford University.[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-22)
63:Gu's second run in the Women's Freeski Halfpipe Qualification at the [2020 Winter Youth Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2020_Winter_Youth_Olympics "2020 Winter Youth Olympics")
75:Gu's coaches have included Jamie Melton, head coach of the Chinese National Slopestyle and Big Air Training Team for the 2022 Winter Olympics,[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-24) and Brad Prosser, who met Gu when she was ten. In 2018, he became the technical coach guide to the Chinese national team for the 2022 Winter Olympics. Her personal coach for the 2022 Olympics was Misra Noto Torniainen, the former coach of the Swiss freeski team.[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-25) Torniainen coached Olympic medalists [Sarah Höfflin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sarah_H%C3%B6fflin "Sarah Höfflin") and [Mathilde Gremaud](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mathilde_Gremaud "Mathilde Gremaud") for the [2018 Winter Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2018_Winter_Olympics "2018 Winter Olympics").[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-26)[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-27)
79:At the [2021 Winter X Games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Winter_X_Games_XXV "Winter X Games XXV"), Gu won a bronze medal in [Big Air](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Big_Air "Big Air") and two gold medals in [SuperPipe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Superpipe "Superpipe") and [Slopestyle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Slopestyle "Slopestyle"), becoming the first rookie to win a gold medal in Women's Ski SuperPipe, the first rookie to medal in three events, and the first athlete representing China to win a gold medal at the X Games.[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-30)[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-31)[[32]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-32)
81:Gu withdrew from the 2023 Winter X Games due to a heavy crash in training where she injured her knee.[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-33)
83:At the 2024 [Winter X Games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/X_Games "X Games"), Gu won gold in [SuperPipe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Superpipe "Superpipe") despite injuring her right hip during the X Games Slopestyle training. She wrote "Pain is Temporary" on her hand, and showed it to the cameras during the finals. Due to the pain, she did not participate in [Slopestyle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Slopestyle "Slopestyle").[[34]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-34)
85:### World Championships
87:[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Eileen_Gu&action=edit&section=5 "Edit section: World Championships")]
89:Gu competed at the [FIS Freestyle Ski and Snowboarding World Championships 2021](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FIS_Freestyle_Ski_and_Snowboarding_World_Championships_2021 "FIS Freestyle Ski and Snowboarding World Championships 2021"), winning two gold medals in Freeski Halfpipe and Freeski Slopestyle and a bronze medal in Freeski Big Air. Gu became the first freeskier to win two golds at the FIS Freeski World Championship.[[35]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-35)[[36]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-36) She competed without poles for the first time due to a broken hand, having fractured a finger and tearing the UCL in her thumb.[[37]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-37)[[38]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-38)[[39]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-:4-39)
91:### 2022 Winter Olympics
93:[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Eileen_Gu&action=edit&section=6 "Edit section: 2022 Winter Olympics")]
95:At the [2022 Winter Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_Winter_Olympics "2022 Winter Olympics") in Beijing, Gu became the youngest gold medalist in freestyle skiing, winning the [big air](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skiing_at_the_2022_Winter_Olympics_%E2%80%93_Women's_big_air "Freestyle skiing at the 2022 Winter Olympics – Women's big air") freestyle skiing event, the first to be held at the Olympics.[[40]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-40) Gu landed a double cork 1620, her first attempt in competition.[[41]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-41) She was the second woman to land the trick and the first woman to land a left-turn 1620;[[42]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-42)[Tess Ledeux](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tess_Ledeux "Tess Ledeux") first successfully completed a double cork 1620 on 21 January 2022, at the [X Games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/X_Games "X Games") in Aspen, Colorado,[[43]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-43) Gu landed it again in her first run of the big air final at the 2022 Winter Olympics.[[44]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-44)[[45]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-45)
97:Gu won the silver medal in the [slopestyle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skiing_at_the_2022_Winter_Olympics_%E2%80%93_Women's_slopestyle "Freestyle skiing at the 2022 Winter Olympics – Women's slopestyle") event.[[46]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-46) She won a second gold medal in the women's freeski halfpipe competition, becoming the first freestyle skier to win three medals at a Winter Olympics.[[47]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-branch1-47)[[48]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-autogenerated1-48) She was awarded the [Best Breakthrough Athlete](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Best_Breakthrough_Athlete_ESPY_Award "Best Breakthrough Athlete ESPY Award") and [Best Female Action Sports Athlete ESPY Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Best_Female_Action_Sports_Athlete_ESPY_Award "Best Female Action Sports Athlete ESPY Award") at the [2022 ESPY Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_ESPY_Awards "2022 ESPY Awards").[[49]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-49)[[50]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-50)
99:Gu ended the [2021–22 World Cup](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2021%E2%80%9322_FIS_Freestyle_Ski_World_Cup "2021–22 FIS Freestyle Ski World Cup") season with a perfect record in women's halfpipe, taking her first career [crystal globe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FIS_Freestyle_Ski_World_Cup "FIS Freestyle Ski World Cup") and becoming the first freestyle skier to win four consecutive World Cup competitions.[[51]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-51)[[52]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-52)[[53]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-53) She won a second crystal globe during the same season, placing first in park and pipe overall.[[54]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-54)

123:### 2026 Winter Olympics
125:[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Eileen_Gu&action=edit&section=8 "Edit section: 2026 Winter Olympics")]
127:At the [2026 Winter Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Winter_Olympics "2026 Winter Olympics") in Milan-Cortina, Eileen Gu competed in all three women's freestyle skiing disciplines: [slopestyle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skiing_at_the_2026_Winter_Olympics_%E2%80%93_Women's_slopestyle "Freestyle skiing at the 2026 Winter Olympics – Women's slopestyle"), [big air](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skiing_at_the_2026_Winter_Olympics_%E2%80%93_Women's_big_air "Freestyle skiing at the 2026 Winter Olympics – Women's big air"), and the [freeski halfpipe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skiing_at_the_2026_Winter_Olympics_%E2%80%93_Women's_halfpipe "Freestyle skiing at the 2026 Winter Olympics – Women's halfpipe"), medaling in each.[[56]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-harpur2-56) Gu secured silver medals in both slopestyle and big air, and won the gold medal in the halfpipe, defending her title from the [2022 Winter Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_Winter_Olympics "2022 Winter Olympics").[[56]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-harpur2-56) Gu posted a top score of 94.75 in the halfpipe final, finishing ahead of compatriot [Li Fanghui](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Li_Fanghui "Li Fanghui")'s score of 93.00 (silver) and Great Britain's [Zoe Atkin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zoe_Atkin "Zoe Atkin")'s 92.50 (bronze).[[56]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-harpur2-56)
129:With three medals won in Milan-Cortina and three from the 2022 Beijing Games, Gu's total of six Olympic gold or silver medals in six events made her the most decorated freestyle skier in Olympic history.[[56]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-harpur2-56)[[57]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-gregory-57) Alongside Russian cross-country skier [Lyubov Yegorova](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lyubov_Yegorova_(cross-country_skier) "Lyubov Yegorova (cross-country skier)"), Gu became the second athlete in history to earn either gold or silver in each of their first six individual Winter Olympic events.[[57]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-gregory-57)

165:Mascot ceremony of freestyle skiing — women's halfpipe at the [2020 Winter Youth Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2020_Winter_Youth_Olympics "2020 Winter Youth Olympics") in [Lausanne](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lausanne "Lausanne"), Switzerland, on 20 January 2020. Left to right: [Li Fanghui](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Li_Fanghui "Li Fanghui"), Eileen Gu and [Hanna Faulhaber](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hanna_Faulhaber "Hanna Faulhaber")
167:Gu competed for the United States at the 2018–19 FIS Freestyle Ski World Cup. She began competing for China in June 2019 after requesting a change of national affiliation with the [International Ski Federation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Ski_Federation "International Ski Federation"). Her goal was to compete for China in the 2022 Winter Olympics.[[58]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-:0-58)[[59]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-:1-59)[[60]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-60) She announced the change on [Weibo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sina_Weibo "Sina Weibo")[[61]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-:74-61) and Instagram,[[59]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-:1-59) stating that through skiing she hopes "to help inspire millions of young people" in China and "to unite people, promote common understanding, create communication, and forge friendships between nations".[[58]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-:0-58)
181:Prior to the start of the 2022 Winter Olympics, Gu was the face of multiple brands in China. Gu has endorsed brands in China across sports, fashion, and banking. Some of her partnerships in China include [Mengniu Dairy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mengniu_Dairy "Mengniu Dairy"), [Luckin Coffee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Luckin_Coffee "Luckin Coffee"), [JD.com](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/JD.com "JD.com"), [China Mobile](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/China_Mobile "China Mobile"), [People's Insurance Company of China](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/People's_Insurance_Company_of_China "People's Insurance Company of China"), [Bank of China](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bank_of_China "Bank of China"), [Anta Sports](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anta_Sports "Anta Sports"), and [Bosideng](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bosideng "Bosideng").[[71]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-:6-71)[[72]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-:5-72)
195:Gu has stated that her broad purpose from international attention is to have "global beneficial impact" through her fashion and skiing.[[83]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-harpur3-83)[[84]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-84) One estimate from the Chinese government is that more than 300 million people began participation in ice and snow sports since the 2022 Winter Olympics when Gu first competed.[[83]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-harpur3-83)

37:**Eileen Feng Gu** (born September 3, 2003), also known by her [Chinese name](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinese_name#In_English "Chinese name")**Gu Ailing** (谷爱凌), is a Chinese-American [freestyle skier](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skier "Freestyle skier") and model.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-3) She has represented China in [halfpipe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Half-pipe_skiing "Half-pipe skiing"), [slopestyle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Slopestyle "Slopestyle"), and [big air](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Big_air "Big air") events since the 2018–19 season. With three gold and three silver medals, Gu is the most decorated freestyle skier in [Olympic history](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skiing_at_the_Winter_Olympics "Freestyle skiing at the Winter Olympics").
39:Gu was born and raised in the United States. She began competing for China in 2019. At age 18, she became the youngest Olympic champion in freestyle skiing after winning gold medals in [big air](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skiing_at_the_2022_Winter_Olympics_%E2%80%93_Women's_big_air "Freestyle skiing at the 2022 Winter Olympics – Women's big air") and [halfpipe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skiing_at_the_2022_Winter_Olympics_%E2%80%93_Women's_halfpipe "Freestyle skiing at the 2022 Winter Olympics – Women's halfpipe"), and a silver medal in [slopestyle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skiing_at_the_2022_Winter_Olympics_%E2%80%93_Women's_slopestyle "Freestyle skiing at the 2022 Winter Olympics – Women's slopestyle"), at the [2022 Winter Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_Winter_Olympics "2022 Winter Olympics") in Beijing. She is the first freestyle skier to win three medals at a single Winter Olympics.
41:At the [2026 Winter Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Winter_Olympics "2026 Winter Olympics") in Milan-Cortina, Gu won gold in women's halfpipe and two additional silver medals in big air and slopestyle, setting the Olympic medal record in freestyle skiing, surpassing all previous competitors regardless of gender.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-4)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-5)
59:Gu earned early admittance to [Stanford University](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stanford_University "Stanford University") in December 2020.[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-Paul_LifestyleAsia-16) She entered the freshman class in 2022,[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-17)[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-Paul_LifestyleAsia-16) the same year she was presented as a [debutante](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Debutante "Debutante") at [Le Bal des débutantes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Le_Bal_des_d%C3%A9butantes "Le Bal des débutantes") in Paris.[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-18) While at Stanford, she joined [Kappa Kappa Gamma](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kappa_Kappa_Gamma "Kappa Kappa Gamma") sorority and studied abroad at the [University of Oxford](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_of_Oxford "University of Oxford")'s [Magdalen College.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Magdalen_College,_Oxford "Magdalen College, Oxford")[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-19)[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-20) An [international relations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_relations "International relations") major, Gu took time off in the 2025–26 academic year to prepare for the [2026 Winter Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Winter_Olympics "2026 Winter Olympics").[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-21) In June 2026, Gu graduated from Stanford University.[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-22)
63:Gu's second run in the Women's Freeski Halfpipe Qualification at the [2020 Winter Youth Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2020_Winter_Youth_Olympics "2020 Winter Youth Olympics")
75:Gu's coaches have included Jamie Melton, head coach of the Chinese National Slopestyle and Big Air Training Team for the 2022 Winter Olympics,[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-24) and Brad Prosser, who met Gu when she was ten. In 2018, he became the technical coach guide to the Chinese national team for the 2022 Winter Olympics. Her personal coach for the 2022 Olympics was Misra Noto Torniainen, the former coach of the Swiss freeski team.[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-25) Torniainen coached Olympic medalists [Sarah Höfflin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sarah_H%C3%B6fflin "Sarah Höfflin") and [Mathilde Gremaud](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mathilde_Gremaud "Mathilde Gremaud") for the [2018 Winter Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2018_Winter_Olympics "2018 Winter Olympics").[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-26)[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-27)
79:At the [2021 Winter X Games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Winter_X_Games_XXV "Winter X Games XXV"), Gu won a bronze medal in [Big Air](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Big_Air "Big Air") and two gold medals in [SuperPipe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Superpipe "Superpipe") and [Slopestyle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Slopestyle "Slopestyle"), becoming the first rookie to win a gold medal in Women's Ski SuperPipe, the first rookie to medal in three events, and the first athlete representing China to win a gold medal at the X Games.[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-30)[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-31)[[32]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-32)
81:Gu withdrew from the 2023 Winter X Games due to a heavy crash in training where she injured her knee.[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-33)
83:At the 2024 [Winter X Games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/X_Games "X Games"), Gu won gold in [SuperPipe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Superpipe "Superpipe") despite injuring her right hip during the X Games Slopestyle training. She wrote "Pain is Temporary" on her hand, and showed it to the cameras during the finals. Due to the pain, she did not participate in [Slopestyle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Slopestyle "Slopestyle").[[34]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-34)
85:### World Championships
87:[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Eileen_Gu&action=edit&section=5 "Edit section: World Championships")]
89:Gu competed at the [FIS Freestyle Ski and Snowboarding World Championships 2021](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FIS_Freestyle_Ski_and_Snowboarding_World_Championships_2021 "FIS Freestyle Ski and Snowboarding World Championships 2021"), winning two gold medals in Freeski Halfpipe and Freeski Slopestyle and a bronze medal in Freeski Big Air. Gu became the first freeskier to win two golds at the FIS Freeski World Championship.[[35]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-35)[[36]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-36) She competed without poles for the first time due to a broken hand, having fractured a finger and tearing the UCL in her thumb.[[37]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-37)[[38]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-38)[[39]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-:4-39)
91:### 2022 Winter Olympics
93:[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Eileen_Gu&action=edit&section=6 "Edit section: 2022 Winter Olympics")]
95:At the [2022 Winter Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_Winter_Olympics "2022 Winter Olympics") in Beijing, Gu became the youngest gold medalist in freestyle skiing, winning the [big air](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skiing_at_the_2022_Winter_Olympics_%E2%80%93_Women's_big_air "Freestyle skiing at the 2022 Winter Olympics – Women's big air") freestyle skiing event, the first to be held at the Olympics.[[40]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-40) Gu landed a double cork 1620, her first attempt in competition.[[41]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-41) She was the second woman to land the trick and the first woman to land a left-turn 1620;[[42]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-42)[Tess Ledeux](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tess_Ledeux "Tess Ledeux") first successfully completed a double cork 1620 on 21 January 2022, at the [X Games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/X_Games "X Games") in Aspen, Colorado,[[43]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-43) Gu landed it again in her first run of the big air final at the 2022 Winter Olympics.[[44]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-44)[[45]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-45)
97:Gu won the silver medal in the [slopestyle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skiing_at_the_2022_Winter_Olympics_%E2%80%93_Women's_slopestyle "Freestyle skiing at the 2022 Winter Olympics – Women's slopestyle") event.[[46]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-46) She won a second gold medal in the women's freeski halfpipe competition, becoming the first freestyle skier to win three medals at a Winter Olympics.[[47]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-branch1-47)[[48]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-autogenerated1-48) She was awarded the [Best Breakthrough Athlete](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Best_Breakthrough_Athlete_ESPY_Award "Best Breakthrough Athlete ESPY Award") and [Best Female Action Sports Athlete ESPY Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Best_Female_Action_Sports_Athlete_ESPY_Award "Best Female Action Sports Athlete ESPY Award") at the [2022 ESPY Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_ESPY_Awards "2022 ESPY Awards").[[49]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-49)[[50]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-50)
99:Gu ended the [2021–22 World Cup](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2021%E2%80%9322_FIS_Freestyle_Ski_World_Cup "2021–22 FIS Freestyle Ski World Cup") season with a perfect record in women's halfpipe, taking her first career [crystal globe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FIS_Freestyle_Ski_World_Cup "FIS Freestyle Ski World Cup") and becoming the first freestyle skier to win four consecutive World Cup competitions.[[51]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-51)[[52]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-52)[[53]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-53) She won a second crystal globe during the same season, placing first in park and pipe overall.[[54]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-54)

123:### 2026 Winter Olympics
125:[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Eileen_Gu&action=edit&section=8 "Edit section: 2026 Winter Olympics")]
127:At the [2026 Winter Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Winter_Olympics "2026 Winter Olympics") in Milan-Cortina, Eileen Gu competed in all three women's freestyle skiing disciplines: [slopestyle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skiing_at_the_2026_Winter_Olympics_%E2%80%93_Women's_slopestyle "Freestyle skiing at the 2026 Winter Olympics – Women's slopestyle"), [big air](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skiing_at_the_2026_Winter_Olympics_%E2%80%93_Women's_big_air "Freestyle skiing at the 2026 Winter Olympics – Women's big air"), and the [freeski halfpipe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freestyle_skiing_at_the_2026_Winter_Olympics_%E2%80%93_Women's_halfpipe "Freestyle skiing at the 2026 Winter Olympics – Women's halfpipe"), medaling in each.[[56]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-harpur2-56) Gu secured silver medals in both slopestyle and big air, and won the gold medal in the halfpipe, defending her title from the [2022 Winter Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_Winter_Olympics "2022 Winter Olympics").[[56]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-harpur2-56) Gu posted a top score of 94.75 in the halfpipe final, finishing ahead of compatriot [Li Fanghui](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Li_Fanghui "Li Fanghui")'s score of 93.00 (silver) and Great Britain's [Zoe Atkin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zoe_Atkin "Zoe Atkin")'s 92.50 (bronze).[[56]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-harpur2-56)
129:With three medals won in Milan-Cortina and three from the 2022 Beijing Games, Gu's total of six Olympic gold or silver medals in six events made her the most decorated freestyle skier in Olympic history.[[56]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-harpur2-56)[[57]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-gregory-57) Alongside Russian cross-country skier [Lyubov Yegorova](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lyubov_Yegorova_(cross-country_skier) "Lyubov Yegorova (cross-country skier)"), Gu became the second athlete in history to earn either gold or silver in each of their first six individual Winter Olympic events.[[57]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-gregory-57)

165:Mascot ceremony of freestyle skiing — women's halfpipe at the [2020 Winter Youth Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2020_Winter_Youth_Olympics "2020 Winter Youth Olympics") in [Lausanne](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lausanne "Lausanne"), Switzerland, on 20 January 2020. Left to right: [Li Fanghui](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Li_Fanghui "Li Fanghui"), Eileen Gu and [Hanna Faulhaber](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hanna_Faulhaber "Hanna Faulhaber")
167:Gu competed for the United States at the 2018–19 FIS Freestyle Ski World Cup. She began competing for China in June 2019 after requesting a change of national affiliation with the [International Ski Federation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Ski_Federation "International Ski Federation"). Her goal was to compete for China in the 2022 Winter Olympics.[[58]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-:0-58)[[59]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-:1-59)[[60]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-60) She announced the change on [Weibo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sina_Weibo "Sina Weibo")[[61]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-:74-61) and Instagram,[[59]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-:1-59) stating that through skiing she hopes "to help inspire millions of young people" in China and "to unite people, promote common understanding, create communication, and forge friendships between nations".[[58]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-:0-58)
181:Prior to the start of the 2022 Winter Olympics, Gu was the face of multiple brands in China. Gu has endorsed brands in China across sports, fashion, and banking. Some of her partnerships in China include [Mengniu Dairy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mengniu_Dairy "Mengniu Dairy"), [Luckin Coffee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Luckin_Coffee "Luckin Coffee"), [JD.com](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/JD.com "JD.com"), [China Mobile](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/China_Mobile "China Mobile"), [People's Insurance Company of China](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/People's_Insurance_Company_of_China "People's Insurance Company of China"), [Bank of China](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bank_of_China "Bank of China"), [Anta Sports](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anta_Sports "Anta Sports"), and [Bosideng](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bosideng "Bosideng").[[71]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-:6-71)[[72]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-:5-72)
195:Gu has stated that her broad purpose from international attention is to have "global beneficial impact" through her fashion and skiing.[[83]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-harpur3-83)[[84]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-84) One estimate from the Chinese government is that more than 300 million people began participation in ice and snow sports since the 2022 Winter Olympics when Gu first competed.[[83]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eileen_Gu#cite_note-harpur3-83)

94:[2026年米兰-科尔蒂纳丹佩佐冬奥会](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026%E5%B9%B4%E5%86%AC%E5%AD%A3%E5%A5%A5%E6%9E%97%E5%8C%B9%E5%85%8B%E8%BF%90%E5%8A%A8%E4%BC%9A "2026年冬季奥林匹克运动会")上，谷爱凌再次参加坡面障碍技巧、大跳台和U型场地技巧三个项目的比赛。2026年2月9日，谷爱凌在[坡面障碍技巧](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026%E5%B9%B4%E5%86%AC%E5%AD%A3%E5%A5%A5%E6%9E%97%E5%8C%B9%E5%85%8B%E8%BF%90%E5%8A%A8%E4%BC%9A%E8%87%AA%E7%94%B1%E5%BC%8F%E6%BB%91%E9%9B%AA%E5%A5%B3%E5%AD%90%E5%9D%A1%E9%9D%A2%E9%9A%9C%E7%A2%8D%E6%8A%80%E5%B7%A7%E6%AF%94%E8%B5%9B "2026年冬季奥林匹克运动会自由式滑雪女子坡面障碍技巧比赛")比赛中获得银牌；这是她第二次获得该项目的奥运会亚军[[51]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-54)。 16日，她在[大跳台](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026%E5%B9%B4%E5%86%AC%E5%AD%A3%E5%A5%A5%E6%9E%97%E5%8C%B9%E5%85%8B%E8%BF%90%E5%8A%A8%E4%BC%9A%E8%87%AA%E7%94%B1%E5%BC%8F%E6%BB%91%E9%9B%AA%E5%A5%B3%E5%AD%90%E5%A4%A7%E8%B7%B3%E5%8F%B0%E6%AF%94%E8%B5%9B "2026年冬季奥林匹克运动会自由式滑雪女子大跳台比赛")项目中获得亚军[[52]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-55)。22日，以94.75分的成绩，蝉联冬奥会[U型场地](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026%E5%B9%B4%E5%86%AC%E5%AD%A3%E5%A5%A5%E6%9E%97%E5%8C%B9%E5%85%8B%E8%BF%90%E5%8A%A8%E4%BC%9A%E8%87%AA%E7%94%B1%E5%BC%8F%E6%BB%91%E9%9B%AA%E5%A5%B3%E5%AD%90U%E5%9E%8B%E5%9C%BA%E5%9C%B0%E6%8A%80%E5%B7%A7%E6%AF%94%E8%B5%9B "2026年冬季奥林匹克运动会自由式滑雪女子U型场地技巧比赛")项目冠军[[53]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-56)。
100:谷爱凌2019年6月在[国际滑雪联合会](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%9B%BD%E9%99%85%E6%BB%91%E9%9B%AA%E8%81%94%E5%90%88%E4%BC%9A "国际滑雪联合会")更改運動国籍为[中華人民共和国](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E4%B8%AD%E5%8D%8E%E4%BA%BA%E6%B0%91%E5%85%B1%E5%92%8C%E5%9B%BD "中华人民共和国")，开始代表中国参赛[[61]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-65)[[62]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-66)[[63]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-67)，在[2022年冬季奥林匹克运动会](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022%E5%B9%B4%E5%86%AC%E5%AD%A3%E5%A5%A5%E6%9E%97%E5%8C%B9%E5%85%8B%E8%BF%90%E5%8A%A8%E4%BC%9A "2022年冬季奥林匹克运动会")中以中華人民共和國國籍參賽。 《[奥林匹克宪章](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A5%A5%E6%9E%97%E5%8C%B9%E5%85%8B%E5%AE%AA%E7%AB%A0 "奥林匹克宪章")》第41条允许[双重国籍](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%8F%8C%E9%87%8D%E5%9B%BD%E7%B1%8D "双重国籍")或多重国籍，但参赛者必须是其代表的国家的国民；该条及该条的附属立法亦规定，持有双重国籍者可以代表任何一个国籍国参与赛事，但在首次代表任何国家参与奥运会、洲运会或世锦赛后，不得再代表其他国家，但因加入别国国籍、国家变更（分裂、合并、独立）等原因，经执委会批准则属例外，可在最后一次代表原国籍国参赛三年之后，代表新国籍国参赛[[64]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-Olympic-Charter-68)。
108:[德国之声](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%BE%B7%E5%9B%BD%E4%B9%8B%E5%A3%B0 "德国之声")的报道指出：中国现行的《国籍法》颁布于1980年，此后再无任何修订。该法总共只有18条，行文异常简单，因此在许多细节问题上相当粗略。例如当一名外籍人士自愿申请加入中国国籍时，《国籍法》没有具体规定自愿加入中国国籍者究竟应在多少天内放弃原有外国国籍。中国行政机关也没有就《国籍法》公布过统一的执行细则或者实施条例。从多个中国驻外使领馆的网站上，都能看到存在一些模棱两可的例外情况。该报道认为谷爱凌的冬奥参赛资格并无问题，而媒体以及社交网站更为关心的问题则是谷爱凌究竟是否具有双重国籍、是否违反了中国《国籍法》。[[69]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-73)
112:2022年6月7日据美国[《时代周刊》](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E6%99%82%E4%BB%A3%E9%9B%9C%E8%AA%8C "時代雜誌")报道，谷爱凌在TIME 100峰会上表示，自己将担任美国申办2030年或2034年盐湖城冬奥会的大使；不后悔自己代表中国参加北京冬奥会。[[77]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-lian-81)有一些中国大陆网民以此认定谷爱凌为美国国籍。[[78]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-82)据报道经常有参与申办奥运会的国家和城市邀请与本地有渊源、也有全球知名度的运动员担任申奥大使，以帮助它们在海外进行形象推广和宣传，如美籍华裔网球运动员[张德培](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%BC%A0%E5%BE%B7%E5%9F%B9 "张德培")、中国运动员[丁俊晖](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E4%B8%81%E4%BF%8A%E6%99%96 "丁俊晖")、中国滑雪运动员[申雪](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E7%94%B3%E9%9B%AA "申雪")和[赵宏博](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B5%B5%E5%AE%8F%E5%8D%9A "赵宏博")等。[[77]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-lian-81)[[79]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-huan-83)6月8日，《环球时报》发表社评称部分美国媒体对中国一些网民言论的强化和夸大是美国国内政治狭隘、社会严重撕裂、对少数族裔“不信任”等心态的自我投射，以及将中国舆论节奏向“极端民族主义”引导和刻画。[[79]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-huan-83) 《[联合早报](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%81%94%E5%90%88%E6%97%A9%E6%8A%A5 "联合早报")》则认为，一些网民狭隘的爱国主义本身就与竞技体育中的国际化有冲突，在中美两国民族主义情绪不断蔓延的今天，谷爱凌想游走的中间模糊地带会越来越狭窄[[80]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-84)。
114:谷爱凌爱好广泛，除了滑雪外还擅长跑步、篮球、钢琴等，曾作为签约模特多次登上杂志封面[[81]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-85)。[2024年巴黎奥运会](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024%E5%B9%B4%E5%B7%B4%E9%BB%8E%E5%A5%A5%E8%BF%90%E4%BC%9A "2024年巴黎奥运会")马拉松大众组比赛中，谷愛凌以3小時24分36秒於逾萬名跑者中名列女子組前200[[82]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-86)。

94:[2026年米兰-科尔蒂纳丹佩佐冬奥会](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026%E5%B9%B4%E5%86%AC%E5%AD%A3%E5%A5%A5%E6%9E%97%E5%8C%B9%E5%85%8B%E8%BF%90%E5%8A%A8%E4%BC%9A "2026年冬季奥林匹克运动会")上，谷爱凌再次参加坡面障碍技巧、大跳台和U型场地技巧三个项目的比赛。2026年2月9日，谷爱凌在[坡面障碍技巧](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026%E5%B9%B4%E5%86%AC%E5%AD%A3%E5%A5%A5%E6%9E%97%E5%8C%B9%E5%85%8B%E8%BF%90%E5%8A%A8%E4%BC%9A%E8%87%AA%E7%94%B1%E5%BC%8F%E6%BB%91%E9%9B%AA%E5%A5%B3%E5%AD%90%E5%9D%A1%E9%9D%A2%E9%9A%9C%E7%A2%8D%E6%8A%80%E5%B7%A7%E6%AF%94%E8%B5%9B "2026年冬季奥林匹克运动会自由式滑雪女子坡面障碍技巧比赛")比赛中获得银牌；这是她第二次获得该项目的奥运会亚军[[51]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-54)。 16日，她在[大跳台](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026%E5%B9%B4%E5%86%AC%E5%AD%A3%E5%A5%A5%E6%9E%97%E5%8C%B9%E5%85%8B%E8%BF%90%E5%8A%A8%E4%BC%9A%E8%87%AA%E7%94%B1%E5%BC%8F%E6%BB%91%E9%9B%AA%E5%A5%B3%E5%AD%90%E5%A4%A7%E8%B7%B3%E5%8F%B0%E6%AF%94%E8%B5%9B "2026年冬季奥林匹克运动会自由式滑雪女子大跳台比赛")项目中获得亚军[[52]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-55)。22日，以94.75分的成绩，蝉联冬奥会[U型场地](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026%E5%B9%B4%E5%86%AC%E5%AD%A3%E5%A5%A5%E6%9E%97%E5%8C%B9%E5%85%8B%E8%BF%90%E5%8A%A8%E4%BC%9A%E8%87%AA%E7%94%B1%E5%BC%8F%E6%BB%91%E9%9B%AA%E5%A5%B3%E5%AD%90U%E5%9E%8B%E5%9C%BA%E5%9C%B0%E6%8A%80%E5%B7%A7%E6%AF%94%E8%B5%9B "2026年冬季奥林匹克运动会自由式滑雪女子U型场地技巧比赛")项目冠军[[53]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-56)。
100:谷爱凌2019年6月在[国际滑雪联合会](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%9B%BD%E9%99%85%E6%BB%91%E9%9B%AA%E8%81%94%E5%90%88%E4%BC%9A "国际滑雪联合会")更改運動国籍为[中華人民共和国](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E4%B8%AD%E5%8D%8E%E4%BA%BA%E6%B0%91%E5%85%B1%E5%92%8C%E5%9B%BD "中华人民共和国")，开始代表中国参赛[[61]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-65)[[62]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-66)[[63]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-67)，在[2022年冬季奥林匹克运动会](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022%E5%B9%B4%E5%86%AC%E5%AD%A3%E5%A5%A5%E6%9E%97%E5%8C%B9%E5%85%8B%E8%BF%90%E5%8A%A8%E4%BC%9A "2022年冬季奥林匹克运动会")中以中華人民共和國國籍參賽。 《[奥林匹克宪章](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A5%A5%E6%9E%97%E5%8C%B9%E5%85%8B%E5%AE%AA%E7%AB%A0 "奥林匹克宪章")》第41条允许[双重国籍](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%8F%8C%E9%87%8D%E5%9B%BD%E7%B1%8D "双重国籍")或多重国籍，但参赛者必须是其代表的国家的国民；该条及该条的附属立法亦规定，持有双重国籍者可以代表任何一个国籍国参与赛事，但在首次代表任何国家参与奥运会、洲运会或世锦赛后，不得再代表其他国家，但因加入别国国籍、国家变更（分裂、合并、独立）等原因，经执委会批准则属例外，可在最后一次代表原国籍国参赛三年之后，代表新国籍国参赛[[64]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-Olympic-Charter-68)。
108:[德国之声](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%BE%B7%E5%9B%BD%E4%B9%8B%E5%A3%B0 "德国之声")的报道指出：中国现行的《国籍法》颁布于1980年，此后再无任何修订。该法总共只有18条，行文异常简单，因此在许多细节问题上相当粗略。例如当一名外籍人士自愿申请加入中国国籍时，《国籍法》没有具体规定自愿加入中国国籍者究竟应在多少天内放弃原有外国国籍。中国行政机关也没有就《国籍法》公布过统一的执行细则或者实施条例。从多个中国驻外使领馆的网站上，都能看到存在一些模棱两可的例外情况。该报道认为谷爱凌的冬奥参赛资格并无问题，而媒体以及社交网站更为关心的问题则是谷爱凌究竟是否具有双重国籍、是否违反了中国《国籍法》。[[69]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-73)
112:2022年6月7日据美国[《时代周刊》](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E6%99%82%E4%BB%A3%E9%9B%9C%E8%AA%8C "時代雜誌")报道，谷爱凌在TIME 100峰会上表示，自己将担任美国申办2030年或2034年盐湖城冬奥会的大使；不后悔自己代表中国参加北京冬奥会。[[77]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-lian-81)有一些中国大陆网民以此认定谷爱凌为美国国籍。[[78]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-82)据报道经常有参与申办奥运会的国家和城市邀请与本地有渊源、也有全球知名度的运动员担任申奥大使，以帮助它们在海外进行形象推广和宣传，如美籍华裔网球运动员[张德培](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%BC%A0%E5%BE%B7%E5%9F%B9 "张德培")、中国运动员[丁俊晖](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E4%B8%81%E4%BF%8A%E6%99%96 "丁俊晖")、中国滑雪运动员[申雪](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E7%94%B3%E9%9B%AA "申雪")和[赵宏博](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B5%B5%E5%AE%8F%E5%8D%9A "赵宏博")等。[[77]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-lian-81)[[79]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-huan-83)6月8日，《环球时报》发表社评称部分美国媒体对中国一些网民言论的强化和夸大是美国国内政治狭隘、社会严重撕裂、对少数族裔“不信任”等心态的自我投射，以及将中国舆论节奏向“极端民族主义”引导和刻画。[[79]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-huan-83) 《[联合早报](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%81%94%E5%90%88%E6%97%A9%E6%8A%A5 "联合早报")》则认为，一些网民狭隘的爱国主义本身就与竞技体育中的国际化有冲突，在中美两国民族主义情绪不断蔓延的今天，谷爱凌想游走的中间模糊地带会越来越狭窄[[80]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-84)。
114:谷爱凌爱好广泛，除了滑雪外还擅长跑步、篮球、钢琴等，曾作为签约模特多次登上杂志封面[[81]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-85)。[2024年巴黎奥运会](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024%E5%B9%B4%E5%B7%B4%E9%BB%8E%E5%A5%A5%E8%BF%90%E4%BC%9A "2024年巴黎奥运会")马拉松大众组比赛中，谷愛凌以3小時24分36秒於逾萬名跑者中名列女子組前200[[82]](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B0%B7%E7%88%B1%E5%87%8C#cite_note-86)。
